learning_objective: The learner can identify the key components of a transformer block, including self-attention mechanisms and feed-forward layers, and explain how they process information in parallel without RNNs.

common_misconceptions.description: Believing the attention mechanism was introduced with the transformer model rather than three years prior.
Assuming transformers rely on recurrent neural networks for sequential processing instead of parallel token processing.
Thinking the transformer architecture is limited to neural machine translation rather than serving as a general foundation model building block.
